svg.text: Two causes of hallucination: never learned it, and" most likely" is not" most true"

g.text: the topic is almost absent from the training data -—
an obscure company, a very recent fact.
The model does not know" I don't know",
so it simply invents a plausible passage.
The training objective only asks" does
it look like the next word",",
scores as high as restating a real fact.
Example:"list the papers published by Zhang San"
Zhang San is a real but obscure scholar. The model never learned his papers,
but" list papers" is a format it has seen many times—so it invents, in the usual format,
five titles, journals and years: every one plausible, every one fabricated.
Both causes are usually present at once: missing knowledge gives it freedom, fluency first gives it nerve.
